# 5. Summoning a Great Islamic Ulama Scholar (spawns native religious_figure:muslim_scholar)
oe_grel.5 = {
	type = country_event
	outcome = positive
	title = oe_grel.5.t
	desc = oe_grel.5.desc
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_wnd_samarkand.dds"

	option = {
		name = oe_grel.5.a
		ai_chance = { base = 40 }
		create_character = {
			adm = { 65 90 }
			dip = { 55 85 }
			mil = { 25 55 }
			age = 38
			birth_location = root.capital
			estate = estate_type:clergy_estate
			culture = root.culture
			religion = root.religion
			religious_school = religious_school:hanafi_school
			religious_figure = religious_figure:muslim_scholar
		}
		if = {
			limit = { modifier:allow_mysticism_vs_jurisprudence = yes }
			change_societal_value = {
				type = mysticism_vs_jurisprudence
				value = societal_value_minor_move_to_right
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_grel.5.b
		ai_chance = { base = 30 }
		create_character = {
			adm = { 60 88 }
			dip = { 65 90 }
			mil = { 20 50 }
			age = 36
			birth_location = root.capital
			estate = estate_type:clergy_estate
			culture = root.culture
			religion = root.religion
			religious_school = religious_school:shafii_school
			religious_figure = religious_figure:muslim_scholar
		}
		add_prestige = 5
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_grel.5.c
		ai_chance = { base = 30 }
		create_character = {
			adm = { 60 85 }
			dip = { 65 92 }
			mil = { 20 50 }
			age = 42
			birth_location = root.capital
			estate = estate_type:clergy_estate
			culture = root.culture
